summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Brera Holdings PLC reporting a registered direct offering of Class B Ordinary Shares under an existing shelf registration statement. On May 21, 2026, the company agreed to sell 2,298,000 shares at an aggregate price of approximately $11.4 million to individual investors without an underwriter. The offering closed on May 27, 2026, with proceeds intended for working capital and general corporate purposes. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or structural complexities are mentioned. This is a standard capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
